cards.topic: Hidden shift · power per AI rack
cards.title: The next AI bottleneck is power
cards.question: Why does higher compute density raise power-chip content per rack?
cards.selfCheck: 800V and vertical delivery add conversion content; test € per kW.
cards.prompt: FACT: Infineon Nov 10 describes 800V distribution, GaN bus converters and vertical power delivery as density rises. HYPOTHESIS: more semiconductor content per kW, not merely more racks, lifts supplier economics. TEST design adoption, power losses, € per kW and shipments. 7d: no verified new company milestone; 30d: Nov 10 results; 90d: Sep 9 SolarEdge 800V breaker collaboration. https://www.infineon.com/assets/row/public/documents/corporate/investors/presentations/2026/2026-11-10-q4-fy26-intro-statement-analyst-call-v01-00-en.pdf https://www.infineon.com/press-release/2026/infpr202609-138

cards.title: Infineon gets paid grid-to-core
cards.question: Could power semiconductors become a larger earnings driver than autos?
cards.selfCheck: FY26 data-center €2.2B; test FY27 €4B ramp and margin.
cards.prompt: FACT: Nov 10 Infineon reported FY26 dedicated AI power €1.7B and broader data-center €2.2B; FY27 data-center outlook nearly €4B. PSS Q4 margin 30.8%. HYPOTHESIS: higher content per kW and Dresden fab utilization improve mix. TEST data-center revenue, Power Systems margin, fab utilization; auto cycle can distort consolidated results. Not an undiscovered thesis. https://www.infineon.com/assets/row/public/documents/corporate/investors/presentations/2026/2026-11-10-q4-fy26-intro-statement-analyst-call-v01-00-en.pdf

cards.title: €10B is not booked revenue
cards.question: What does management's Nov 10 capacity-commitment statement actually prove?
cards.selfCheck: Signed PLUS negotiated €10B; verify binding orders and shipments.
cards.prompt: ORIGINAL management statement Nov 10: cumulative data-center delivery and capacity reservation agreements, BOTH signed and under negotiation, exceeded €10B; some prepayments share capex risk. Do NOT label all as backlog or recognized revenue. FY27 data-center target near €4B. TEST signed share, Dresden fab ramp, quarterly sales and cash conversion in 2–6 months. Earlier Sep 9 800V collaboration is technology evidence, not purchase volume. https://www.infineon.com/assets/row/public/documents/corporate/investors/presentations/2026/2026-11-10-q4-fy26-intro-statement-analyst-call-v01-00-en.pdf

cards.title: Revenue is guided; profit is the test
cards.question: What operating assumption could disappoint despite €4B data-center sales?
cards.selfCheck: Test mix, utilization and €1.8B FCF guidance against capex.
cards.prompt: FACT: Nov 10 company guides FY27 group sales ~€20B, data-center ~€4B, capex €3–3.5B, FCF ~€1.8B. HYPOTHESIS: fab underutilization or slower 800V adoption could make revenue growth less profitable; upside if higher content and mix persist. Current forward multiple and consensus revisions NOT independently verified: no mispricing claim. TEST quarterly segment margin, depreciation, customer conversion and capex. https://www.infineon.com/press-release/2026/infpr202611-025

cards.title: WATCH IFX; gate on cash returns
cards.question: What would upgrade the power thesis over the next two quarters?
cards.selfCheck: WATCH €4B run-rate, margins, FCF; reject missed capacity ramp.
cards.prompt: Educational WATCH, not personalized trading instruction. Require quarterly data-center revenue tracking toward ~€4B FY27, profitable Dresden capacity utilization, and credible FCF path; verify current valuation and consensus before any entry decision. INVALIDATE on persistent fab delays, weaker € per kW, lost design wins, declining margin or capex without cash returns. Next earnings and Dec 7 divisional update are evidence checkpoints, not presumed outcomes. https://www.infineon.com/assets/row/public/documents/corporate/investors/presentations/2026/2026-11-10-q4-fy26-intro-statement-analyst-call-v01-00-en.pdf

cards.title: Count dollars per kilowatt
cards.question: How do you detect a supplier inflection before total AI spend changes?
cards.selfCheck: Separate units × content × margin; validate each link.
cards.prompt: Infineon case: revenue = deployed rack kW × semiconductor € per kW × supplier share, adjusted for timing and price. Nov 10 management emphasizes rising content per kW as 800V and vertical power delivery develop. This is a model, not a disclosed company metric. Cross-check with ALAB switches per rack, COHR optical links, and GF SiGe wafer volume. Test attach, yield, price, cash returns, not just market TAM. https://www.infineon.com/assets/row/public/documents/corporate/investors/presentations/2026/2026-11-10-q4-fy26-intro-statement-analyst-call-v01-00-en.pdf
